entities.summary: Stevie Wonder (b. 1950-05-13, Saginaw) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Saginaw and Ghana. Known in the fields of ghana, poets & playwrights, africa.
